notes.title: Some video games that are like Bandersnatch, but better
notes.content:
If you ve choosed-and-adventured through Bandersnatch, the recent Black Mirror thing on Netflix, and aren t already a fan of experimental interactive fiction: I envy you. It means you re able to play actually good examples of interactive fiction for the first time.

Sure, Bandersnatch has funny lines, surprises and scene stealing performances from Will Poulter doing a pretty much exactly how I, the writer, talk in real life voice. But as a whole, video games have been iterating deeper on the main themes of control, authenticity, forced choice, meta-recursion and non-linearity for years, without also including an unhelpful portrayal of paranoid schizophrenia. When you love enough people who hear voices and suffer from castigatory delusions, maybe you become less enthused about media which depicts sufferers committing murders or throwing themselves off buildings. Fix it, Brooker. The same plotpoint was in White Christmas and it was shit back then.

notes.title: A Tale of Two Announcements! 🍎🍊
notes.content:
These are the best of times, these are the worst of times,
it is the age of wisdom, it is the age of foolishness,
it is the spring of hope, it is the winter of despair,
it is the season of the apple... it is the age of the orange.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/2052544f45d91a9ec6c612147dce7ad88b851a2a.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/20d64f5151732160a70ee37ef88fab00a8043ca6.jpg[/img]

That’s right! You all guessed it months ago! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/927270/Accounting/]Accounting+[/url] is coming to HTC Vive and Oculus Rift very soon with ANOTHER big free update for all platforms. Take a bite out of that!

Over the past few years we have been updating Accounting, filling it with more and more of the madness that comes from the minds of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/crowscrowscrows/]Crows Crows Crows[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Squanch%20Games]Squanch Games[/url]. This release will be the biggest yet - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/927270/Accounting/]Accounting+[/url] on SteamVR will be three times the size of the original!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/927270/Accounting/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/9065f2fbc153cf44275358793821f1d4c69b753a.jpg[/img][/url]

Have you got non-English-speaking friends that you have been just dying to introduce to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/927270/Accounting/]Accounting+[/url]? Well NOW - so long as they speak German, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese or Korean - this is NO LONGER A PROBLEM thanks to our new, multi-language SUBTITLE SYSTEM!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/927270/Accounting/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/69bb40f26e7e76c0dd8937350991d41b9d802380.jpg[/img][/url]

[quote=Some Nerd]“With all of these new levels, won’t it take me even longer to get to my favourite now?”[/quote]

[b]NO![/b] We’ve invented a concept never before seen in games called a “Level Loader.” This beautiful machine is capable of transporting you to absolutely any level that you’ve already completed! Goodbye linearly experiencing the content of this video game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/893c8a9f06555b66c6ee4fa209cb83ca16d3ada7.jpg[/img]

Catch you next time! I love you!!
– Apple








[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/27cacd287702496273b69d9d2e60d668ee159637.jpg[/img]
[url=https://crowscrowscrows.itch.io/museum][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/08f2a0a3f6915a5cad0fda1ec4c4094f4bcd3bb5.jpg[/img][/url]

It's my lifetime ticket to [url=https://crowscrowscrows.itch.io/museum]The Official Crows Crows Crows Discord Community Museum (working title)[/url]...

Yeah. I get it. That’s not as flashy as Big VR’s Accounting+, it's on itch.io... but it’s got spunk. It’s got spirit. It’s got a whole load of art, models and music made by the Crows Crows Crows Discord Community.

I took some pics on the late shift.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/1b37cedf6461c29709cc6fa7f4eea12cb371b132.jpg[/img]

If you’re interested in checkin’ out a bunch of art made by our Discord Community inside a museum built by William, Jakob & Joe of Crows Crows Crows, then get on down there now…

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/285eebf64d1b7261fb5eb00148fa4826fa939d68.jpg[/img]



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/12d6fff140affbe4c619d3aeadfa60fd8e685c51.jpg[/img]

– [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/crowscrowscrows/]Crows Crows Crows[/url]

notes.title: Shhhhhhhh! Please click very gently!! The PC Gamer is sleeping…
notes.content:
[h1]KEEP IT DOWN![/h1]

We can [i]very quietly[/i] announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/CrowsCrowsCrows]Crows Crows Crows[/url] is coming back to Steam! We’ve got a whole coffin full of PC games ready to release this instant- from small PC experiments gone wrong, to our very own Half Life 2: Episode Thr-

SHHHH!!! Don’t say the forbidden phrase!!

Now, before we can release these beauties we need to set a couple of things straight. The last time you saw us on here we’d just released Dr. Langeskov and Accounting. Look at them over there. Waving to us from the past. How little they both knew…

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/40628ccbaa212fa80b531b86143e84a7ed39eff0.gif[/img]

Back in those sepia-snapchat filter days Crows Crows Crows was a smaller collection of dangerous individuals, mostly collaborating remotely via morse code or dropbox. But now we are in the future. Now we have MORE PEOPLE. We have a GOOGLE DRIVE. We have AN OFFICE.

And in this office…

IS A HATCH.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/c9a664256304a51f4f7a4b66678cb9e2c127ffaa.png[/img]

A voice behind us tells us what to do. We listen to the voice and we feed the creature as much as is needed. We should be happy it's there for us. And look, here it goes, giving us a new direction...

Good. Now. We've gotta get the satanic rite out of the way. No way around this one gamers!

OLD ONES FROM THE GREAT BEYOND
JOIN US IN UNHOLY BOND
EVIL WITH UNSPEAKABLE NAMES
WORKING ON SEVERAL PC GAMES
LOTS OF NEW CONTENT FOR YOU TO SEE
IS IT A KART RACER?

notes.title: The 23 best bite-size games for busy lives
notes.content:
I am dad, hear me whinge. Too many games, not enough spare time, for all my non-work hours are spent kissing grazed knees, explaining why you cannot eat the food in that cupboard, constructing awful Lion King dioramas out of toilet roll tubes and being terrified that the next jump from the sofa to the armchair will go fatally wrong. I’m lucky in that my job to some extent involves playing games, so by and large if there’s something I really want to check out I can find a way to, but I appreciate that there are many long-time, older or otherwise time-starved readers for whom RPS is a daily tease of wondrous things they cannot play.

Now, clearly I cannot magically truncate The Witcher 3 into three hours for you, but what I can do is suggest a few games from across the length and breadth of recent PC gaming that can either be completed within a few hours or dipped into now and again without being unduly punished because you’ve lost your muscle-memory. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: A Good Bundle offering 151 games for cheapo
notes.content:
The bohemian sewer of neon lights and indie games known as Itch.io has posted a huge bundle of games from over 100 different creators, pointedly called A Good Bundle. It’s got a lot in it. Gone Home is in there, Catacomb Kids is in there, Proteus is there, The Novelist is there, Killing Time At Lightspeed is there. And a bunch of smaller games of note too: NORTH, Windosill, Raik, FJORDS, The Old Man Club, Depression Quest, Capsule jeepers. The asking price for the whole stash a potentially overwhelming 151 games is 20 United States dollars. There s another motive behind this videogame Voltron though. All of the proceeds are going to the American Civil Liberties Union and Planned Parenthood.

notes.title: Grappling Hook Revision & Bug Fixes - 10th of December 2015
notes.content:
Hello everybody! So we're just pushing out our first major bug fix patch that should solve a good amount of problems that a few of you have been experiencing! We don't hit everything with this update but we'll be along very shortly with the rest. We also added community avatars incase you want to get up in everybody's face with it!
See you soon!

[b]Features[/b][list]
[*]Completely reworked the physics calculation for the grappling hook.
[*]Added an alternate guard path variant for Hard mode.
[*]P completely removes ALL UI for screenshots (previously the map & guard pointers would remain).
[*]You can now paint your vehicle with the airbrush gun you find in the gallery.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list]
[*]Added option for Y-Axis Inversion.
[*]Improved Tiger pathfinding.
[*]The elevator should now start much faster - please let us know if you're still experiencing this bug.
[*]Added option for mouse sensitivity.
[*]Colliders on the cliff segment are now much more forgiving.
[*]Lowered the frequency of the floor clipping issue.
[*]The flamethrower is back for those of you who noticed it was gone.
[*]Possible fix for achievement issues (if you're still having troubles let us know in the Steam Forum).
[*]Fixed several general clipping issues.
[*]Removed turret due to very buggy AI.
[*]Repositioned some valuables to make them easier to steal without crouching/awkward positioning.
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b][list]
[*]Lasers might have been improved? They might be worse? I don't know...
[*]Vehicle slowed down so that the scenery can be appreciated more.
[*]Dynamite now takes 50% longer to arm.
[*]Night vision enabled.
[/list]
